description: Residential Smart Meter Energy Time Series: One month of active power measurements with 1s reporting rate is a data set deposited in IEEE DataPort by its authors Grigore Stamatescu, Mihaela Albu (University Politehnica of Bucharest). The dataset includes active power measurements for a residential dwelling (apartment) located in Bucharest, Romania, collected at 1s second reporting rate over one month.We hope that the dataset is useful to energy systems and computational intelligence researchers for time series forecasting, classification and energy disaggregation tasks.For collecting the energy measurement data SLAMs (Smart Low-Cost Advance ... Coverage: national (RO); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge, and IEEE DataPort normally asks for a free account before download (not tested). The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-ieeedp-repository.
